metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.2 · 2013 · Now You See Me
metas.description: An FBI agent and an Interpol detective track a team of illusionists who pull off bank heists during their performances, and reward their audiences with the money.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.4 · 2016 · Now You See Me 2
metas.description: The Four Horsemen resurface, and are forcibly recruited by a tech genius to pull off their most impossible heist yet.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.9 · 2025 · Now You See Me: Now You Don't
metas.description: The Four Horsemen reunite and team up with a new generation of young illusionists to expose a diamond heiress's global money laundering scheme for criminals.
